_why: Ten Laws #2 — no app holds funds. A wallet must be PERSISTED to be a wallet, so every durable write call is declared here. "balance": true means this key accumulates a per-actor amount treated as owed or held — forbidden, so it demands a quoted founder ruling. A per-ORDER price record is NOT a balance.
_fingerprint: sha256 of the normalised write call. If the call changes, the declaration must be re-read and renewed in the same commit — a batch write cannot silently absorb a new key.
